game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail, the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre: the fire warden must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling obsidian shards into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail: the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Build a flowchart that reads a and b, adds them, and displays their sum. Test dataset 1: {'a': 1, 'b': 3}; {'a': 0, 'b': 2}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Sorter' (Week 2 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Ash Rim Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Protect the magma valve from magma slimes in Ash Rim Trail: keep the sorted_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: sorted_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
source_game_title: Type Sorter – Ash Rim Trail Defense
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
